description: Mobiliers électriques de Paris - Données géographiques is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Région Île-de-France. Vector type data describing certain electrical furniture: terminals for electric vehicles, low voltage sockets.\ Example(s) of data reuse(s): \ - Android app "VuzZz" Google Play\ link. Coverage: Région Île-de-France. The portal shows the English title as "Electric furniture from Paris - Geographical data" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Région Île-de-France. Its keywords include mobilier-urbain, geolocalisation, equipement. The listing shows 2014-11-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
